get_all_folds: get all 8 fold names (fold0 through fold7) used for training model data splits
get_fold_names: get fold names for a given model version and subset like TRAIN, VALID, or TEST
get_fold_intervals: get genomic intervals as a DataFrame filtered by model version, organism, and data subset
Subset_enum: use the Subset enum with TRAIN, VALID, or TEST values to specify which data split to retrieve
review_fold_mapping: review the fold mapping logic that aligns model versions with Borzoi checkpoint validation and test folds
